title: Legacy Netherite
description: Adds a way to get Netherite gear by slaying wither skeletons if you use generation without ancient debris.
body: This Mod makes Netherite functional in nether generation mods that dont spawn ancient debris by adding a new rare drop to wither skeletons that can be mixed with diamonds and gold to make 1 ancient debris, and then from there, Netherite.
